name: databridge-pro
description: DataBridge Pro: live and historical Indian market data from Fyers, Zerodha Kite and Dhan into AmiBroker

scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/with-msvc.cjs npm run tauri --prefix apps/desktop -- dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/with-msvc.cjs npm run tauri --prefix apps/desktop -- build
scripts.build:files: npm run build:server && node scripts/with-msvc.cjs npm run tauri --prefix apps/desktop -- build --no-bundle && node scripts/stage-release.cjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/server && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix apps/server && npm run test --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix apps/desktop --no-audit --no-fund
